notes.title: Update 1.0.2 is Live
notes.notes:
Changelog:
[list]
[*] Added Ukrainian localization
[*] Added 3 new Arcade levels
[*] Added additional visual details
[*] Added the ability to hold L2/R2 on the gamepad to end the timer
[*] Improved UI scaling for large resolutions (2K and up)
[*] Improved input handling
[*] Fixed minor issues
[*] Optimized download size
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 is Live
notes.notes:
Changelog:

[list]
[*] Fixed inability to trigger the 'Game Journalist' achievement
[*] Fixed incorrect assignment of Arcade mode achievements
[/list]

Hint: [spoiler] If you want to trigger the 'Game Journalist' achievement, you need to lose the game in the first level (TestServer2501). [/spoiler]

notes.title: Release Delayed Until 04/28
notes.notes:
Due to various reasons, we've decided to postpone the release until April 28th.

This will give us additional time to polish the game, process user feedback from the demo release, and ensure that the release version meets our quality standards and player expectations.

Thank you for your interest and continued support.
--RS of Graverobber Foundation
